six_line_comparison.algorithm: UTF-8 split on newline; trim each line; remove empty lines and lines starting #; compare consecutive windows of six remaining lines whose newline-joined text has at least120 characters. Includes docstring lines. No AST, renamed-identifier, token-flow, edit-distance or historical ancestry inference.

metadata_only_empty_matches.description: Whole Boltons tree Git OIDs compared with fixed Flask full tree; only empty blob match.

boundaries.old_comparison_scope: 132 actually admitted six-repository DEV source files +2 retained historical implementation files +24 fixed Flask src files +4 historical Werkzeug source modules. Not all historical source versions or all known projects' complete implementation contents.
